notablePrerequisites:
Oathkeeper attached to Su-Chi.
Samurai chosen with Xenograft.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi and Oathkeeper triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Oathkeeper trigger, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Equip Oathkeeper to Su-Chi by paying {2}.
Repeat.
